params.description:
Params is optional: many assertion types take no parameters, so an
entry with only `type:` is valid and must not require an empty
`params: {}` stub. omitempty also drops it from the schema's required set.

pass_threshold.description:
PassThreshold is the minimum pass rate (0.0-1.0) required across trials.
Only meaningful when the parent scenario has Trials > 1.
If unset, defaults to 1.0 (must pass every trial).

AssertionConfig.description: AssertionConfig represents an assertion configuration used in arena scenarios.

tool_called.description: ToolCalled requires an exact tool name to have been called.

tool_called_pattern.description: ToolCalledPattern is a regex that must match at least one tool name.

any_tool_called.description: AnyToolCalled requires at least one tool to have been called.

min_tool_calls.description: MinToolCalls is the minimum number of tool calls required.

AssertionWhen.description: AssertionWhen specifies preconditions that must be met for an assertion to run.

path.description: Optional: relative path to fragment file

FragmentRef.description: FragmentRef references a reusable prompt fragment Reuses the same structure as prompt.FragmentRef for consistency

max_tokens.description:
MaxTokens caps each generated turn exactly. Unset keeps the built-in cap
of 200 tokens (300 when natural termination is enabled, to leave room
for the completion marker).

PersonaDefaults.description: PersonaDefaults contains default LLM parameters for the persona.

id.description: ID names the fact, e.g. order_number.

value.description: Value is what the persona may say, e.g. "A-100".

PersonaFact.description: PersonaFact is one fact a persona holds.

check.description:
Check runs the fidelity check after each of the persona's self-play
turns: an identifier-shaped specific in its message that is in no fact
and nowhere earlier in the conversation is reported as invented.
Default true.

fail_on_violation.description:
FailOnViolation fails the run when the persona invents a specific. By
default the run is only flagged as unreliable, so the simulator's
mistake is not counted as the agent's failure.

PersonaFactPolicy.description: PersonaFactPolicy controls the fidelity check on a persona with facts.

type.description: Type is int, bool or string.

initial.description:
Initial is the value the variable starts a conversation with. Default
0, false or "".

min.description:
Min is an int variable's lowest value; a transition that would go
below it stops there.

max.description:
Max is an int variable's highest value; a transition that would go
above it stops there.

PersonaStateVar.description: PersonaStateVar declares one variable of a persona's state.

equals.description: Equals matches a value of the variable's type.

at_most.description: AtMost matches an int variable at or below the value.

at_least.description: AtLeast matches an int variable at or above the value.

outcome.description:
Outcome labels the stop in the report, e.g. abandoned. Default
"stopped".

fail.description:
Fail fails the run when the condition stops the turn. By default the
stop is reported without failing.

PersonaStopCondition.description: PersonaStopCondition ends the persona's self-play turn when its state matches.

expressive.description:
Expressive opts the persona into TTS characterization markup. When
true, [UserPersonaPack.BuildSystemPrompt] prepends a bracket-tag
rubric (from the resolved TTS provider, or from
CharacterizationRubric below) so the LLM emits "[whispers]" /
"[excited]" / "[laughs]" etc. that downstream provider adapters
lower into their native dialects. Default false — existing personas
produce byte-identical prompts.

characterization_rubric.description:
CharacterizationRubric is an optional override that replaces the
provider-default rubric verbatim. Only consulted when Expressive is
true. Use this when a persona has unusual delivery requirements
(custom tag examples, narrower vocabulary, alternative phrasing).

PersonaStyle.description: PersonaStyle defines behavioral characteristics for the user persona

when.description:
When lists the assertions that, all passing on the exchange just run,
apply the transition. They see only that exchange.

target.description:
Target is what the assertions read: "agent" (the default) checks the
exchange's messages; "persona" checks the persona's own message, as if
it were the reply, so content assertions match what the persona said.

set.description: Set assigns values, each of its variable's type.

add.description: Add adds to int variables; a negative amount subtracts.

PersonaTransition.description: PersonaTransition changes the persona's state after an exchange whose checks all pass.

voice.description:
Voice references an arena-level voice id (see Config.Voices). When
set, selfplay synthesis routes this persona's text through the bound
TTS provider. Empty means the arena falls back to its default voice
or fails fast if no default is configured.

mode.description:
Mode selects how the persona's generated turns are checked. "user"
(the default when empty) warns when a turn stops sounding like a short
user message — more than two sentences, more than two questions, or
assistant-like phrasing. "adversarial" skips those checks, for personas
whose turns are deliberately long or structured (pasted documents,
multi-part requests, role-play setups).

private_notes.description:
PrivateNotes lets the persona keep notes the agent under test never
sees. Text inside <notes>...</notes> in a generated turn is removed
before the turn is sent, and every earlier turn's notes are given back
to the persona as {{persona_notes}}.

facts.description:
Facts are the only specifics (numbers, dates, names, codes) the persona
may state. They are added to its prompt, with an instruction to say it
doesn't have anything else it is asked for, and are available to a
system_template as {{facts}}.

fact_policy.description: FactPolicy controls how the persona's turns are checked against Facts.

state.description:
State declares typed variables the harness keeps for the persona across
a conversation, such as patience or whether it has given its order
number. A system_template reads them as {{state.<name>}}, or all of
them as {{state}}.

transitions.description:
Transitions update State after each self-play exchange whose checks
pass, in order.

stop_when.description:
StopWhen ends the persona's self-play turn when its state matches a
condition, such as patience reaching 0. The first condition that
matches is reported as the turn's outcome.

UserPersonaPack.description: UserPersonaPack defines how the User LLM behaves in self-play scenarios

description: User persona configuration for self-play scenarios
